Higher Education Committee
Thursday, March 9, 2023
3:00 PMLivestream YouTube

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert J. Kupec,
Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: Senator Robert D. Farnsworth

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:00pm

Call to order

S.F. 1702: Senator Kupec: Grant program establishment for in-need colleges.

Senator Kupec moved that S.F. 1702, be laid over. - MOTION ADOPTED.
S.F. 2242: Senator Putnam: Hunger-Free Campus program modification.

Gavel was transferred to Senator Oumou Verbeten at 3:22pm and returned to Chair Fateh at 3:38pm

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 2242, be laid over.

S.F. 2306: Senator Putnam: Postsecondary student basic needs working group establishment.

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 2306, be laid over. - MOTION ADOPTED.

S.F. 1515: Senator Putnam: Postsecondary student voter registration provisions modification.

Motion that SF 1515 be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Committee on Elections passed on a voice vote
Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 1515, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the Elections Committee.
The meeting was adjourned at 4:14
